operation.description:
Adds a repository to the list of repositories that can access a self-hosted runner group. The runner group must have `visibility` set to `selected`. For more information, see "[Create a self-hosted runner group for an organization](#create-a-self-hosted-runner-group-for-an-organization)."

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Add repository access to a self-hosted runner group in an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/parameters/repository-id.description: The unique identifier of the repository.
#/components/parameters/repository-id.name: repository_id

#/components/parameters/runner-group-id.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner group.
#/components/parameters/runner-group-id.name: runner_group_id
